/apps/backup-vps.lisp:
; /apps/backup-vps.lisp — Download a snapshot of the current VFS
(eval-file "/apps/gui.lisp")
(define cadr (fn (lst) (car (cdr lst))))
(define fmt-bytes (fn (n)
  (if (< n 1024) (concat (str n) " B")
      (if (< n 1048576) (concat (str (floor (/ n 1024))) " KB")
          (concat (str (floor (/ n 1048576))) " MB")))))
(define sum-bytes (fn (pairs)
  (if (= (length pairs) 0) 0
      (+ (cadr (car pairs)) (sum-bytes (cdr pairs))))))

(let ((summary (el "div" (hash "class" "text-[11px] text-emerald-300 font-mono truncate") "Loading..."))
      (list-box (gui-list))
      (download-btn (gui-btn "" "emerald" nil "w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2"))
      (refresh-btn (gui-btn "Refresh" "ghost" nil))
      (root (el "div" (hash "class" "flex flex-col h-full bg-[#0c1019]")
                (gui-header summary refresh-btn)
                list-box
                (gui-footer download-btn))))
  (set-html! download-btn (concat (icon-svg "save" 14) " Download snapshot"))
  (define refresh (fn ()
    (set-text! summary "Loading...")
    (let ((pairs (fs-snapshot-files!)))
      (gui-list-clear! list-box)
      (map (fn (pair)
             (let ((p (car pair))
                   (bytes (cadr pair))
                   (row (el "div" (hash "class" "flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-slate-300 px-1"))))
               (append-child! row (el "span" (hash "class" "truncate") p))
               (append-child! row (el "span" (hash "class" "text-os-muted shrink-0") (fmt-bytes bytes)))
               (append-child! list-box row)))
           pairs)
      (set-text! summary (concat (str (length pairs)) " files · " (fmt-bytes (sum-bytes pairs)))))))
  (on-click refresh-btn (fn () (refresh)))
  (on-click download-btn (fn () (fs-download-snapshot!)))
  (refresh)
  (gui-window "Backup VFS" 440 460 root))
/apps/calculator.lisp:
; /apps/calculator.lisp
(eval-file "/apps/gui.lisp")

(let ((expr "")
      (display (el "div"
                   (hash "class" "w-full bg-black/60 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg p-3 text-right font-mono text-xl text-sky-300 overflow-x-auto overflow-y-hidden mb-3 min-h-[48px]")
                   "0")))

  (define update-display
    (fn (val)
      (set! expr val)
      (set-text! display (if (= expr "") "0" expr))))

  (define press-key
    (fn (ch)
      (cond
        ((= ch "C") (update-display ""))
        ((= ch "⌫") (update-display (slice expr 0 (- (length expr) 1))))
        ((= ch "=")
         (let ((res (js-eval-math expr)))
           (update-display (str res))))
        (#t (update-display (concat expr ch))))))

  (define make-btn
    (fn (label accent)
      (let ((cls (if accent
                     "p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-sky-500/20 hover:bg-sky-500/35 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/30 font-mono font-semibold text-sm transition cursor-pointer"
                     "p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 font-mono text-sm transition cursor-pointer")))
        (let ((btn (el "button" (hash "class" cls) label)))
          (on-click btn (fn () (press-key label)))
          btn))))

  (let ((keys (list "C" "(" ")" "/"
                    "7" "8" "9" "*"
                    "4" "5" "6" "-"
                    "1" "2" "3" "+"
                    "0" "." "⌫" "="))
        (grid (el "div" (hash "class" "grid grid-cols-4 gap-2"))))

    (map (fn (k)
           (let ((is-op (or (= k "=") (= k "C") (= k "/") (= k "*") (= k "-") (= k "+"))))
             (append-child! grid (make-btn k is-op))))
         keys)

    (let ((root (el "div" (hash "class" "p-4 flex flex-col h-full bg-slate-900/60")
                    display
                    grid)))
      (gui-window "Lisp Calculator" 280 370 root))))

/apps/editor.lisp:
; /apps/editor.lisp — Open, edit, save & run any VFS file
(eval-file "/apps/file-manager.lisp")
(eval-file "/apps/gui.lisp")

(let ((path-input (gui-input "noname" "noname or /path" "flex-1 font-mono text-xs text-white focus:border-os-accent"))
      (textarea (el "textarea" (hash "class" "flex-1 bg-[#151a28] text-slate-100 p-2 font-mono text-xs focus:outline-none resize-none")))
      (load-btn (gui-btn "Load" "ghost" nil))
      (save-btn (gui-btn "Save" "mint" nil))
      (run-btn (gui-btn "Run" "accent" nil)))
  (define current-path
    (fn ()
      (let ((p (get-val path-input)))
        (if (or (= p "") (= p "noname")) nil p))))
  (define load-file
    (fn (p)
      (set-val! path-input p)
      (set-val! textarea (fs-read p))))
  (define do-load
    (fn ()
      (let ((p (current-path)))
        (pick-file "Open File"
          (fn (sel) (load-file sel))
          (if p (fs-parent-dir p) "/")))))
  (define do-save
    (fn ()
      (let ((p (current-path)))
        (pick-file "Save File"
          (fn (sel)
            (set-val! path-input sel)
            (fs-write sel (get-val textarea))
            (notify "Editor" (concat "Saved to " sel)))
          (if p (fs-parent-dir p) "/")
          p))))
  (define do-run
    (fn ()
      (lisp-run-console (concat "Run: " (get-val path-input)) (get-val textarea))))
  (on-click load-btn do-load)
  (on-click save-btn do-save)
  (on-click run-btn do-run)
  (on-keydown path-input (fn (e)
    (if (= (event-key e) "Enter")
        (if (current-path) (load-file (get-val path-input)) (notify "Editor" "Type a path or press Save to pick one."))
        nil)))
  (set-val! textarea "")
  (gui-window "Lisp Editor" 560 380
    (gui-col
        (gui-row path-input load-btn save-btn run-btn)
        textarea)))
/apps/file-icons.lisp:
; /apps/file-icons.lisp — File & folder icons for the file manager (inline SVG)
; Shared, side-effect-free icon library. Loaded by /apps/file-manager.lisp.
; Edit this file to customize the icons. icon-folder / icon-file / icon-code
; are raw SVG strings; (icon-for name is-dir) picks one per entry.
(define icon-folder "<svg width='16' height='16' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='#fbbf24' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M22 19a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h5l2 3h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z'/></svg>")
(define icon-file "<svg width='16' height='16' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='#94a3b8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z'/><polyline points='14 2 14 8 20 8'/></svg>")
(define icon-code "<svg width='16' height='16' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='#7dd3fc' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><polyline points='16 18 22 12 16 6'/><polyline points='8 6 2 12 8 18'/></svg>")

(define icon-for
  (fn (name is-dir)
    (if is-dir
        icon-folder
        (let ((ext (fs-ext name)))
          (if (or (= ext "lisp") (= ext "js") (= ext "py") (= ext "json") (= ext "sh") (= ext "html") (= ext "css"))
              icon-code
              icon-file)))))
/apps/file-manager.lisp:
; /apps/file-manager.lisp — Minimal VFS file manager / picker.
; (pick-file title on-pick [start-dir] [select-target] [download?]) — calls on-pick with the chosen path.
; dblclick a folder to enter it; dblclick a file calls on-pick (or downloads it when download? is truthy).
; Rename doubles as Move: give it a full path, e.g. /apps/x.lisp -> /backup/x.lisp.
(eval-file "/apps/file-icons.lisp")
(eval-file "/apps/gui.lisp")

(define cadr  (fn (lst) (car (cdr lst))))
(define caddr (fn (lst) (car (cdr (cdr lst)))))
(define starts-with (fn (s prefix)
  (if (< (length s) (length prefix)) #f (= (slice s 0 (length prefix)) prefix))))

(define pick-file
  (fn (title on-pick start-dir select-target download?)
    (let ((current-dir (if start-dir (fs-normalize-path start-dir) "/"))
          (sel-path nil)
          (sel-is-dir nil)
          (sel-btn nil)
          (list-box (gui-list))
          (up-btn (gui-btn "↑ Up" "ghost" nil))
          (refresh-btn (gui-btn "↻" "ghost" nil))
          (location-input (gui-input "/" "" "bg-black/40 focus:border-os-accent"))
          (new-file-btn (gui-btn "+ File" "accent" nil))
          (new-folder-btn (gui-btn "+ Folder" "accent" nil))
          (rename-btn (gui-btn "Rename" "amber" nil))
          (delete-btn (gui-btn "Delete" "danger" nil))
          (download-btn (gui-btn "⬇ Download" "accent" nil "font-semibold"))
          (footer (if download? (gui-footer download-btn) (el "div" (hash "class" "hidden"))))
          (root (list
                    (gui-header up-btn refresh-btn (gui-label "Path:") location-input)
                    (gui-header new-file-btn new-folder-btn rename-btn delete-btn)
                    list-box
                    footer)))
      (define select
        (fn (path is-dir btn)
          (if sel-btn (remove-class sel-btn "bg-white/10") nil)
          (add-class btn "bg-white/10")
          (set! sel-btn btn)
          (set! sel-path path)
          (set! sel-is-dir is-dir)))
      (define navigate
        (fn (dir)
          (if (starts-with dir "/")
              (begin (set! current-dir (fs-normalize-path dir))
                     (refresh))
              (notify "File Manager" "Path must start with /"))))
      (define refresh
        (fn ()
          (set-html! list-box "")
          (set! sel-path nil)
          (set! sel-is-dir nil)
          (set! sel-btn nil)
          (map (fn (entry)
                 (let ((name (car entry))
                       (path (cadr entry))
                       (is-dir (caddr entry))
                       (btn (el "button" (hash "class" "w-full text-left px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5"))))
                   (append-child! btn (gui-icon-html (icon-for name is-dir) "w-4 shrink-0 flex items-center"))
                   (append-child! btn (el "span" (hash "class" "truncate") name))
                   (on-click btn (fn () (select path is-dir btn)))
                   (on-dblclick btn (fn ()
                     (if is-dir
                         (navigate path)
                         (if download?
                             (begin (fs-download-file! path)
                                    (notify "Download" (concat "Downloading " path)))
                             (begin (on-pick path) (close-window win-id))))))
                   (append-child! list-box btn)
                   (if (and select-target (= path select-target))
                       (select path is-dir btn)
                       nil)))
               (fs-list-dir current-dir))
          (set-val! location-input current-dir)))
      (define new-file
        (fn ()
          (let ((name (prompt "New file name:" "")))
            (if (and name (not (= name "")))
                (fs-write (fs-join current-dir name) "")
                nil)
            (refresh))))
      (define new-folder
        (fn ()
          (let ((name (prompt "New folder name:" "")))
            (if (and name (not (= name "")))
                (fs-write (fs-join current-dir name ".keep") "")
                nil)
            (refresh))))
      (define require-selection
        (fn ()
          (if (not sel-path) (notify "File Manager" "Select a file or folder first.") sel-path)))
      (define rename-selected
        (fn ()
          (if (not (require-selection))
              nil
              (let ((dest (prompt "Rename or move to (full path):" sel-path)))
                (if (and dest (not (= dest "")) (not (= dest sel-path)))
                    (if sel-is-dir
                        (let ((old-prefix (concat sel-path "/")))
                          (map (fn (p) (fs-rename p (concat dest (slice p (length sel-path)))))
                               (filter (fn (p) (starts-with p old-prefix)) (fs-list))))
                        (fs-rename sel-path dest))
                    nil)))
          (refresh)))
      (define delete-selected
        (fn ()
          (if (not (require-selection))
              nil
              (if (confirm (concat "Delete " sel-path "?"))
                  (if sel-is-dir
                      (map fs-delete
                           (filter (fn (p) (starts-with p (concat sel-path "/"))) (fs-list)))
                      (fs-delete sel-path))
                  nil))
          (refresh)))
      (define download-selected
        (fn ()
          (if (not sel-path)
              (notify "Download" "Select a file first.")
              (if sel-is-dir
                  (notify "Download" "Folders can't be downloaded — select a file.")
                  (begin (fs-download-file! sel-path)
                         (notify "Download" (concat "Downloading " sel-path)))))))
      (on-click up-btn (fn () (navigate (fs-parent-dir current-dir))))
      (on-click refresh-btn refresh)
      (on-click new-file-btn new-file)
      (on-click new-folder-btn new-folder)
      (on-click rename-btn rename-selected)
      (on-click delete-btn delete-selected)
      (on-click download-btn download-selected)
      (on-keydown location-input (fn (e)
        (if (= (event-key e) "Enter")
            (navigate (get-val location-input))
            nil)))
      (refresh)
      (define win-id (gui-window title 460 400 root)))))
/apps/gui.lisp:
; /apps/gui.lisp — Minimal GUI library for LambdaOS apps.
; Load with: (eval-file "/apps/gui.lisp")
; Side-effect free: defines only gui-* symbols.
;
; Window / layout:
;   (gui-window title width height body)   — themed create-window wrapper
;   (gui-col & kids)                       — flex column root with padding + gap
;   (gui-row & kids)                       — horizontal row
;   (gui-header & kids)                    — row with border-b (top bar)
;   (gui-footer & kids)                    — row with border-t (bottom bar)
;   (gui-section text)                     — uppercase muted section label
;   (gui-label text)                      — plain muted inline label
;
; Widgets:
;   (gui-input value placeholder extra-class?)  — themed monospace input
;   (gui-btn text variant on-click [extra])     — themed button; variant:
;       ghost accent mint danger amber emerald sky
;   (gui-icon name size cls)               — builtin icon container div
;   (gui-icon-html svg cls)                — raw-SVG icon container div
;   (gui-banner kind & kids)               — colored banner row; kind: danger amber sky
;   (gui-card title & kids)                — panel card with accent title
;   (gui-drop-zone [extra-class] & kids)   — dashed drop-target container
;   (gui-list)                             — flex-1 scrollable list container
;   (gui-list-clear! box)                  — empty it
;   (gui-list-row box text [icon])         — append a row; icon optional
;   (gui-render! box items render-fn)      — clear box, then map render-fn over items
;   (gui-empty text)                       — centered muted empty-state
;   (gui-status text)                      — footer status line
;   (gui-app-root kids...)                 — alias of gui-col

(define gui-btn-variants
  (hash "ghost"   "px-2 py-1 rounded bg-white/10 text-slate-300 text-[11px] hover:bg-white/20"
        "accent"  "px-2 py-1 rounded bg-os-accent/20 text-os-accent text-[11px] font-semibold hover:bg-os-accent/30"
        "mint"    "px-2 py-1 rounded bg-os-mint text-slate-950 text-[11px] font-semibold hover:opacity-90"
        "danger"  "px-2 py-1 rounded bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 text-[11px] hover:bg-rose-500/30"
        "amber"   "px-2 py-1 rounded bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 text-[11px] hover:bg-amber-500/30"
        "emerald" "px-3 py-2 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 text-[11px] font-semibold hover:bg-emerald-500/30"
        "sky"     "px-2 py-1 rounded bg-sky-500/20 text-sky-300 text-[11px] hover:bg-sky-500/30"))

(define gui-btn-base "px-2 py-1 rounded bg-white/10 text-slate-300 text-[11px] hover:bg-white/20")

(define gui-window
  (fn (title width height body)
    (create-window title width height
      (el "div" (hash "class" "flex flex-col h-full bg-[#0c1019]") body))))

(define gui-col
  (fn (& kids)
    (el "div" (hash "class" "flex flex-col h-full p-3 gap-2") kids)))
(define gui-app-root gui-col)

(define gui-row (fn (& kids)
  (el "div" (hash "class" "flex items-center gap-2") kids)))

(define gui-header (fn (& kids)
  (el "div" (hash "class" "flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 border-b border-os-border") kids)))

(define gui-footer (fn (& kids)
  (el "div" (hash "class" "flex items-center gap-2 p-3 border-t border-os-border") kids)))

(define gui-label
  (fn (text)
    (let ((d (el "span" (hash "class" "text-[11px] text-os-muted"))))
      (set-text! d text)
      d)))

(define gui-section
  (fn (text)
    (let ((d (el "div" (hash "class" "text-[10px] text-os-muted uppercase tracking-wider"))))
      (set-text! d text)
      d)))

(define gui-input
  (fn (value placeholder & args)
    (let ((extra (car args)))
      (el "input" (hash "class" (concat "flex-1 bg-[#0c1019] border border-os-border rounded px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-emerald-300 focus:outline-none"
                                        (if extra (concat " " extra) ""))
                        "value" value
                        "placeholder" placeholder)))))

(define gui-btn
  (fn (text variant on-click & args)
    (let ((extra (car args)))
      (let ((btn (el "button" (hash "class" (concat (or (hash-get gui-btn-variants variant) gui-btn-base)
                                                    (if extra (concat " " extra) ""))))))
        (set-text! btn text)
        (if on-click (on-click btn on-click) nil)
        btn))))

(define gui-icon
  (fn (name size cls)
    (let ((d (el "div" (hash "class" cls))))
      (set-html! d (icon-svg name size))
      d)))

(define gui-icon-html
  (fn (svg cls)
    (let ((d (el "div" (hash "class" cls))))
      (set-html! d svg)
      d)))

(define gui-banner-variants
  (hash "danger" "px-3 py-2 rounded border border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 text-[11px] leading-snug flex items-center gap-2"
        "amber"  "px-3 py-2 rounded border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 text-[11px] leading-snug flex items-center gap-2"
        "sky"    "px-3 py-2 rounded border border-sky-500/30 bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-300 text-[11px] leading-snug flex items-center gap-2"))

(define gui-banner
  (fn (kind & kids)
    (el "div" (hash "class" (or (hash-get gui-banner-variants kind) (hash-get gui-banner-variants "sky"))) kids)))

(define gui-card
  (fn (title & kids)
    (let ((box (el "div" (hash "class" "p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-os-border"))))
      (append-child! box (el "h3" (hash "class" "font-mono text-os-accent font-semibold mb-1") title))
      (map (fn (k) (append-child! box k)) kids)
      box)))

(define gui-drop-zone
  (fn (extra & kids)
    (el "div" (hash "class" (concat "border-2 border-dashed border-os-border rounded-lg h-24 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 text-slate-400 hover:border-os-accent hover:text-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer select-none"

/apps/repl.lisp:
; /apps/repl.lisp — A tiny Lisp REPL written in Lisp
; Can be launched as an app (opens the window) and used as a library:
;   (repl-run code) — evaluates code, records it in the history,
;   opening the window on first use.
(eval-file "/apps/gui.lisp")

(define repl-out nil)
(define repl-hist "")

(define repl-append (fn (text)
  (set! repl-hist (concat repl-hist text))
  (if repl-out (set-text! repl-out repl-hist) nil)))

(define repl-run (fn (code)
  (repl-ensure-window)
  (let ((res (eval-str-catch code)))
    (if (hash-get res "ok")
        (repl-append (concat "\n> " code "\n=> " (str (hash-get res "value")) "\n"))
        (repl-append (concat "\n> " code "\n✖ " (str (hash-get res "error")) "\n"))))
  nil))

(define repl-ensure-window
  (fn ()
    (if repl-out
        (set-text! repl-out repl-hist)
        (let ((out (el "div" (hash "class" "flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 font-mono text-xs whitespace-pre-wrap text-slate-200 selectable")))
              (input (el "textarea" (hash "class" "flex-1 h-24 bg-[#131826] border border-os-border text-white px-2 py-1 font-mono text-xs focus:outline-none resize-none placeholder:text-slate-600" "placeholder" "λ>")))
              (btn (gui-btn "Eval" "mint" nil "self-stretch px-3 font-bold")))
          (define do-eval
            (fn ()
              (let ((code (get-val input)))
                (if (not (= code ""))
                    (begin (repl-run code) (set-val! input ""))
                    nil))))
          (on-click btn do-eval)
          (on-keydown input (fn (e)
            (if (and (= (event-key e) "Enter") (event-shift? e))
                (begin (event-prevent! e) (do-eval))
                nil)))
          (set! repl-out out)
          (set-text! out repl-hist)
          (gui-window "Lisp REPL" 460 340
            (list out (gui-footer input btn)))))))

; Open the window when launched as an app (eval-file from the desktop icon).
; The editor also eval-files this, lazily, on first Run.
(repl-ensure-window)
/apps/restore-vps.lisp:
; /apps/restore-vps.lisp — Restore the VFS from a snapshot (REPLACES ALL FILES)
(eval-file "/apps/gui.lisp")
(define cadr (fn (lst) (car (cdr lst))))
(define fmt-bytes (fn (n)
  (if (< n 1024) (concat (str n) " B")
      (if (< n 1048576) (concat (str (floor (/ n 1024))) " KB")
          (concat (str (floor (/ n 1048576))) " MB")))))

(let ((banner (el "div" (hash "class" "px-3 pt-3")
                  (gui-banner "danger"
                    (el "span" (hash "class" "w-5 h-5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-rose-500 text-slate-950 text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center") "!")
                    (el "span" (hash "class" "") "Restoring replaces EVERY file in the VFS, including /init.lisp and your edits."))))
      (drop-zone (gui-drop-zone "mx-3 mt-2"))
      (info (el "div" (hash "class" "px-3 pt-2 text-[11px] font-mono text-os-muted") "No snapshot loaded"))
      (list-box (el "div" (hash "class" "flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2 mx-3 my-1 rounded border border-os-border/60 font-mono text-[11px]")))
      (status (el "div" (hash "class" "px-3 text-[10px] text-os-muted font-mono") "Download a backup first if you want to keep the current VFS."))
      (restore-btn (gui-btn "Restore VFS (replace all files)" "danger" nil "w-full py-2 text-[12px] opacity-40 pointer-events-none")))
  (append-child! drop-zone (gui-icon "restore" 22 "text-rose-300"))
  (append-child! drop-zone (el "div" (hash "class" "text-[12px]") "Drop lambda_os_snapshot.json here or click to browse"))
  (define enable (fn () (remove-class restore-btn "opacity-40") (remove-class restore-btn "pointer-events-none")))
  (define disable (fn () (add-class restore-btn "opacity-40") (add-class restore-btn "pointer-events-none")))
  (define on-picked (fn (result)
    (if result
        (let ((count (car result))
              (bytes (cadr result))
              (paths (cdr (cdr result))))
          (gui-list-clear! list-box)
          (map (fn (p) (gui-list-row list-box p)) paths)
          (set-text! info (concat (str count) " files · " (fmt-bytes bytes)))
          (set-text! status "Snapshot parsed — review the list, then click Restore.")
          (enable))
        (begin
          (set-text! info "Invalid snapshot file")
          (set-text! status "Expected a snapshot JSON object: { files: { path: content } }")
          (disable)))))
  (fs-restore-drop! drop-zone on-picked)
  (on-click drop-zone (fn () (fs-pick-restore! on-picked)))
  (on-click restore-btn (fn () (fs-do-restore!)))
  (gui-window "Restore VFS" 440 500
    (list banner drop-zone info list-box status (gui-footer restore-btn))))

; /apps/todo.lisp — Persistent To-Do List App built in Lisp
(eval-file "/apps/gui.lisp")

(let ((items (list "Explore the Lisp REPL" "Edit /init.lisp" "Build a custom OS widget"))
      (list-box (el "div" (hash "class" "flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 pr-1")))
      (input (gui-input "" "Add a new task..." "rounded-lg")))

  (define render-todos
    (fn ()
      (set-html! list-box "")
      (map (fn (item)
             (let ((row (el "div" (hash "class" "flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-800/70 border border-slate-700/80 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-200")))
                   (lbl (el "span" (hash "class" "truncate pr-2") item))
                   (del (el "button" (hash "class" "text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 font-mono px-1.5 cursor-pointer") "✕")))
               (on-click del (fn ()
                               (set! items (filter (fn (x) (not (= x item))) items))
                               (render-todos)))
               (append-child! row lbl)
               (append-child! row del)
               (append-child! list-box row)))
           items)))

  (define add-todo
    (fn ()

        list-box))
  (render-todos))
/apps/upload-file.lisp:
; /apps/upload-file.lisp — Drop files into the VFS (default /uploads).
; Overwrite of an existing file is confirmed before writing.
(eval-file "/apps/gui.lisp")

(let ((dest (gui-input "/uploads" ""))
      (clear-btn (gui-btn "Clear" "ghost" nil "ml-auto"))
      (drop-zone (el "div" (hash "class" "border-2 border-dashed border-os-border rounded-lg h-28 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:border-os-accent hover:text-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer select-none")))
      (list-box (gui-list))
      (status (gui-status "No files uploaded yet"))
      (root (gui-col
                (gui-row (gui-label "Destination:") dest)
                drop-zone
                (gui-row (gui-section "Uploaded") clear-btn)
                list-box
                status)))
  (append-child! drop-zone (gui-icon "upload" 26 "text-sky-300"))
  (append-child! drop-zone (el "div" (hash "class" "text-[12px]") "Drop files here or click to browse"))
  (define report (fn (paths)
    (map (fn (p) (gui-list-row list-box p "upload")) paths)
    (set-text! status (concat (str (length paths)) " file(s) uploaded"))))
  (define clear-list (fn ()
    (gui-list-clear! list-box)
    (set-text! status "No files uploaded yet")))
  (define ask-overwrite (fn (p) (confirm (concat "Overwrite " p "?"))))
  (fs-upload-drop! drop-zone (fn () (get-val dest)) report ask-overwrite)
  (on-click drop-zone (fn () (fs-upload-browse! (fn () (get-val dest)) report ask-overwrite)))
  (on-click clear-btn clear-list)
  (gui-window "Upload File" 420 430 root))
